name: Barbell conventional deadlift
definition: Stand with feet inside the hands and a loaded barbell at floor level. Grip the bar and stand by extending the hips and knees, then return the bar to the floor.

catalogue_anchor.notes: Original broad muscle labels retained separately; not silently promoted to accepted anatomy.

value.start: Stand with feet inside the hands and a loaded barbell at floor level.
value.movement: Grip the bar and stand by extending the hips and knees, then return the bar to the floor.
value.finish: Finish each repetition with the bar returned to its floor start.
value.range_of_motion: Floor-to-standing and return; starting height depends on the loaded plates.
